annotations.title: Exercises for a muscle and the equipment the user has

description: Exercises for a muscle and the equipment the user has. For requests like "what can I do for chest with no equipment?", "glute exercises with bands", "back exercises with dumbbells", "some mobility moves". Give a muscle, equipment or both.

equipment.description: Equipment: none, dumbbells, barbell, gym, bands, kettlebell, pullupbar or jumprope.

level.description: Level: beginner leaves out harder moves.

muscle.description: Muscle: chest, back, shoulders, arms, biceps, triceps, legs, quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves, core (or abs), cardio or mobility. Also forearms (grip) and traps.
